title: pi-go configuration
description: Schema for ~/.pi-go/config.json and project .pi-go/config.json. Line comments (//) are allowed in the file. See config.example.jsonc in the repository for a commented example.

$schema.description: Point at this schema for editor autocompletion and validation.

roles.description: Named model configurations (default, smol, slow, plan, commit), selectable via CLI flags.

model.description: Model name; a declared-provider prefix ("corp/...") routes to that provider.

provider.description: Provider override; empty auto-detects from the model name prefix.

advisorModel.description: Advisor model for the advisor tool (e.g. "claude-opus-4-7").

fallbackModels.description: Models tried in order when this role's primary model is unavailable (402/403/429 quota/5xx). Provider-prefixed names ("corp/...") allowed.

advisorMaxUses.description: Max advisor calls per request (0 = unlimited).

defaultModel.description: Deprecated: use roles.default.model. Migrated at load.

defaultProvider.description: Provider used when a role names no provider and the model prefix is unknown (e.g. "anthropic").

defaultAgent.description: Primary agent (frontmatter mode: primary or all in ~/.pi-go/agents/*.md) the interactive session starts in. Unknown names fall back to the built-in agent.

thinkingLevel.description: Reasoning effort for models that support it.

theme.description: TUI color theme (e.g. "default", "dark-one"). Custom themes are registered from ~/.pi-go/themes.

baseURLs.description: Provider base URLs, keyed by provider name ("ollama", "anthropic", ...). Environment variables override these.

extraHeaders.description: Static HTTP headers sent with every LLM request. ${VAR} expands from ~/.pi-go/.env or the environment; ${SESSION_ID} is replaced per session.

insecureSkipTLS.description: Turn off TLS verification for every endpoint. Prefer caCertPath.

maxOutputTokens.description: Output cap in tokens on OpenAI-compatible paths. Zero uses the provider default (64000). This is an output cap, not a context window.

streamIdleTimeout.description: Abort a streaming LLM request that has delivered no chunks for this many milliseconds; the failure is classified retryable and handed to the retry budget. Default 90000 (90s); 0 disables the abort. PI_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS overrides per process.

midTurnAttempts.description: How many times a turn may run in total when a transient failure cuts it short mid-reply (the 'stream stalled, retrying' budget). Default 3 — the first attempt plus two replays; 0 or 1 turns the replays off. Values outside 0..10 fall back to the default with a warning. PI_MIDTURN_ATTEMPTS overrides per process.

caCertPath.description: PEM bundle trusted in addition to the system roots, for TLS-intercepting corporate proxies.

traceHTTP.description: Log every LLM request and response in full to the session log and OTel spans. The log contains the entire conversation in cleartext.

planAutoFix.description: Run the automatic plan-repair loop after /plan. Default: on. Set false to disable.

tools.description: Per-tool settings; keys and values are tool-specific.

mcp.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers declared in config.json. Project .pi-go/mcp.json servers are merged in separately.

url.description: Streamable HTTP transport endpoint. ${VAR} expands from .pi-go/.env or the environment.

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers for the URL transport.

oauth.description: Run the OAuth authorization-code flow on first connect.

hooks.description: Shell commands triggered on tool events (e.g. post-write formatting).

tools.description: Restrict the hook to these tools.

permission.description: Tool permission gates (opencode-compatible flat shape): each key is a tool-name glob with an allow/deny/ask directive; "bash" holds command-line rules. ask is a hard denial in non-interactive sessions.

bash.description: Bash command patterns. The array form preserves declaration order; on a specificity tie the later rule wins. An object of pattern → directive is also accepted (read in sorted pattern order).

pattern.description: Glob over the whole command line, e.g. "git *".

contextWindow.description: Global context-window override in tokens, for models absent from the embedded catalog. A per-model providers.<name>.models.<model>.contextWindow wins over this.

rateLimits.description: Outbound request pacing, keyed by provider name ("gemini", "agentgateway", ...); "*" is the fallback. Fields are pointers: missing inherits the built-in default, explicit 0 turns the budget off.

providers.description: User-declared providers. The key becomes a model-name prefix: "corp-claude" serves "corp-claude/claude-opus-5". Names must not shadow built-in providers and may contain only [A-Za-z0-9._-].

baseURL.description: Endpoint every request goes to. Already the full endpoint: /chat/completions and /models are appended, /v1 is never added. ${VAR} expands at load.

apiKey.description: Credential sent with requests. ${VAR} expands at load, so the secret can live in .pi-go/.env. A literal apiKey wins over apiKeyEnv.

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable to read the key from when apiKey is empty.

headers.description: Static HTTP headers sent with every request to this provider. ${VAR} expands from .pi-go/.env or the environment; ${SESSION_ID} survives load and is replaced per session.

models.description: Per-model metadata, keyed by the model name as sent to the endpoint (after the "name/" prefix).

contextWindow.description: Context window in tokens; declared here so auto-compaction works for models absent from the embedded catalog.

compactor.description: Tool-output compaction settings. Nil section means the tools-package defaults apply.

autoCompact.description: Auto-compaction thresholds as a percentage of the context window. Defaults: shed at 60%, summarize at 88%.

shed_percent.description: Share at which superseded tool results are dropped (no LLM call).

summarize_percent.description: Share at which a summarizing rebuild runs. Clamped to 95.

compression_model_role.description: Role used to summarize memory; default "smol".

compressor.description: How a recorded tool call becomes an observation: "none" records raw events, "subagent" spawns a child process per tool call.

attention.description: Terminal attention signals: bell and desktop notification when an approval dialog opens or a long turn completes.

bell.description: Ring the terminal bell (ASCII BEL). Default true.

notify.description: Send an OSC 777 desktop notification. Default true.

ollama_model.description: Embedding model. Changing it invalidates every stored vector — re-run `pi memory mine`.

local_embedder.description: Force the slower in-process model instead of Ollama.

embeddings_url.description: External OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint, root up to /embeddings (e.g. http://llm.internal:8000/v1). Set to use it ahead of Ollama and the in-process model.

embeddings_model.description: Model name sent to embeddings_url; default bge-m3. Changing it invalidates every stored vector — re-run `pi memory mine`.

embeddings_api_key.description: Bearer token for embeddings_url; empty sends no Authorization header. Secret: never logged.

llms.description: llms.txt documentation sources served to the fetch_docs tool.

url.description: https URL of an llms.txt index; grants the whole host.

skillsDirs.description: Overrides the default skill directory discovery. When set, only these directories are searched (plus bundled skills and plugins); the user-level ~/.pirate/skills and the project .pirate/skills, .claude/skills, .cursor/skills directories are skipped. PI_SKILLS_DIRS (colon-separated, like PATH) overrides per process.

disableLegacySkillDirs.description: Excludes .claude/skills and .cursor/skills from skill discovery. .pirate/skills and ~/.pirate/skills are unaffected. PI_DISABLE_LEGACY_SKILLS=1 overrides per process.

directive.description: allow passes the call through; deny blocks with an error the model sees; ask blocks in non-interactive sessions and opens the TUI approval dialog otherwise.
